Vendored from FatFs R0.16 (ChaN), the official release archive https://elm-chan.org/fsw/ff/arc/ff16.zip (FatFs Home Page,
https://elm-chan.org/fsw/ff/, "FatFs R0.16 ... Latest Patch July 10, 2026"), downloaded 2026-10-18.
SHA-256 of ff16.zip (computed on the download; the site publishes no hash):
99f7dc1f7e095356e4a9e3dbe29959090d8b948afe2bbc5441e52fdf4b85449e

Licence: the FatFs licence, a BSD-style 1-clause licence (LICENSE.txt of the archive, copied verbatim into this directory;
the same text heads every source file). THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md at the repository root quotes it.

Files taken from the archive's source/ directory: ff.h, diskio.h, ffunicode.c (UNMODIFIED), and ff.c, which carries the two
official patches of https://elm-chan.org/fsw/ff/patches.html ("Known Problems and Patches", item 3, July 10, 2026: "To fix
these problems apply patch-2 to ff.c with patch-1"; they fix CVE-2026-6682, CVE-2026-6683 and CVE-2026-6687: a broken FAT or
exFAT BPB and an exFAT volume label with a manipulated length, which a card an attacker prepared could trigger):
  patch-1  https://elm-chan.org/fsw/ff/patch/ff16p1.diff   SHA-256 7996ddc3135f3d534a8153f7d75d587030e5c8551b003c3b7ee823ffb7fc64bf
  patch-2  https://elm-chan.org/fsw/ff/patch/ff16p2.diff   SHA-256 5cd39f1fc299f0f1dec9fa1ce544dc0bc048b2f6eb3b8161476ed20f9cf1e290
The archive's files have CRLF line ends and the diffs LF; each diff was applied to an LF copy of ff.c in order (patch 1, then
patch 2) and the CRLF line ends were restored, which reproduces the archive's ff.c byte for byte before the patches (checked
by SHA-256). The patched ff.c's banner reads "R0.16 w/patch 2". The patches' only other effects are the new MIN_FAT12,
MIN_VOLUME and MIN_EXFAT checks of the volume geometry.
Not taken: ffsystem.c (needs no OS layer: FF_FS_REENTRANT 0, FF_USE_LFN 1), diskio.c (an example glue), the documents and
the other files of the archive.

config/ffconf.h is MARV's (a copy of the archive's ffconf.h, revision ID 80386, with the options listed in its header
comment changed); CMakeLists.txt is MARV's.
